Start with this repository's `AGENTS.md`, `.michelslab/project.yml`, `MICHELS_LAB_PROJECT.md`, current product log(s) (docs/GIT_AUDIT_LOG.md; docs/DEVELOPMENT_PLAN_FIELD_REGIONS_AND_CAD_2026-10-19.md), current code/UX evidence, and canonical `michels-lab/Michel-Software-Standards/standards/PERSPECTIVE_COUNCIL_STANDARD.md`. If master cross-repo access is absent, state it. **Scientific OpenFOAM case inspection, 2D/3D Field, Data, Analysis, CAD/mesh, time series, phase change and numerical provenance on Windows/local Web.** Do not confuse hypothesized opportunities with shipped or runtime-verified capabilities.

Trace case import, Data browsing, Field 3D navigation, region/time selection, Analysis interpretation, missing data, loading failures, workspace ownership and persistent vital controls. Report friction grounded in real screen/workflow evidence: first-time versus returning, desktop versus mobile, loading/empty/error/recovery states, accessibility, discoverability and time-to-goal. Preserve approved layouts and branding. Suggest the smallest coherent usable change and how it must be verified on the **actual platform**. Explicitly identify what should be simplified or removed; do not claim to have executed physical runtime checks.
